cohort: 344 asylum-seeking women and 2323 Dutch women who gave birth in a northern region of the Netherlands between January 2012 and December 2016
finding: Pregnant asylum seekers had a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including perinatal mortality, intrauterine fetal death, lower birth weight, and small for gestational age, independent of parity, birth weight, and gestational age at birth.
mod_finding: Labour was less often induced in asylum seekers (36.9% vs. 43.8%, p = 0.016).
birth_weight: Asylum seekers: 3265 g, Dutch women: 3385 g
